what: The single closed AnalyticalClause vocabulary and the invariant that lets one atomic analytical result be referenced by every registered audience without changing any semantic field.
protected_field_rule: Every AnalyticalClause field except record_sha256 is protected. The record digest is recomputed over the complete typed record with only record_sha256 omitted. There is no protected-field allowlist and no unprotected clause extension point.
role_reference_rule: A role carries exact clause references only. It may not carry a copied clause payload, editable protected fields, rendering prose, a local proof claim, or an unregistered literal.

measurement.why: A future registered profile may omit a whole atomic measurement, never rewrite it.

limitation.why: A shorter audience view may not keep a fact while dropping what it cannot support.

rights.why: Exact evidence use and release-rights identity travel with the analytical set.

provenance.why: Exact source records and proof binding are mandatory in every role projection.

omission_rule: The source-bound v0.1 profile is deny-by-default and registers no omissions. Every role partition must therefore include the complete clause denominator and carry an empty omitted set.
claim_boundary: The proof establishes only that all seven registered roles reference the same incumbent AnalyticalClause records from one recomputed source bundle. It does not establish prose equivalence, source truth, causal validity, publication approval, production authentication, ProductManifest closure, or correction blast.
product_manifest_future_seam: Unavailable in v0.1. A future ProductManifest must bind exact clause and artifact references, a deterministic closed selection_scope and query, a candidate-universe receipt, and the complete manifest-set denominator. Correction blast must derive predecessor reverse dependencies UNION scopes matching predecessor or successor; this contract does not guess or authorize that closure.
